title: Readiness Estimator: AR Game Worlds 2.0
definition: Estimates AR Game Worlds 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six AR Game Worlds 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a world hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where AR clouds monitoring, world logistics redundancy, or shared anchors maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: AR Game Worlds 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for AR Game Worlds 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for AR Game Worlds 2.0 — next-gen persistent AR game worlds.

Phase 1 — Prove (AR clouds): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (world logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (shared anchors): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cheat defense): world hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and gamers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
